rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THE MAGNA CARTA FOR TAXPAYERS
rows.title_short: Providing The Magna Carta For Taxpayers
rows.abstract:
Seeks to provide increased protection of taxpayers´ rights in complying with their obligation to pay national and local taxes to the government.
Creates the Office of the National Taxpayer Advocate (ONTA) which shall protect the rights of taxpayers in terms of representation of low-income taxpayers who have dispute with Revenue Authorities, provide education, and engage in regular information and communication programs on tax laws, to ensure that the public is properly apprised thereof.
Integrates the Taxpayers´ Bill of Rights and Obligation in all public and private higher education curriculum.

rows.author: J047;
rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING A “ONE TOWN, ONE TOURIST ATTRACTION PROGRAM” TO
PROMOTE TOURISM AND SUSTAINABLE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Tasks the DOT, DPWH, DICT, AND DENR, in partnership with the LGUs to provide the following assistance to cities and municipalities as regards to:
a) identification of tourist destinations and cultural attractions; b) tourism action plan and program c) tourism roads, including the surrounding road networks; d) workshops/capability building re: potentials and opportunities of tourism for residents; e) securing permits, parameters and creation of a system to protect the environment andÂ preserve the culture and way of life of the locals; and f) tools and platform for promotion including multimedia campaigns, and local/international travel fairs.
States that DOT and other agencies implementing OTAP shall prioritize cities and municipalities without tourism programs; provides that those with natural tourist destinations (caves, falls, rock formations, beaches and sanctuaries, and manmade structures) with potential tourist appeal, or those with unique and interesting cultural events and practices (unique fiesta celebrations, food hubs, and parades) may also receive appropriate assistance.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2024-03-11

rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER PROMOTING ENTREPRENEURSHIP BY STRENGTHENING, EMPOWERING, AND ENHANCING THE FINANCING AND OTHER SUPPORT PROGRAMS FOR MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6977, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “MAGNA CARTA FOR MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES (MSMEs)”
rows.title_short: Further Promoting Entrepreneurship By Strengthening, Empowering, And Enhancing The Financing And Other Support Programs For Micro, Small And Medium Enterprises, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 6977, As Amended, Otherwise Known As The " Magna Carta For Micro, Small And Medium Enterprises ( M S M E S)"
rows.abstract:
Aims to promote, support, strengthen and encourage the growth and development of MSMEs in all productive sectors of the economy particularly rural/agri-based, MANUFACTURING, FINANCE AND SERVICES enterprises.
Seeks to recognize the specific needs of the MSMEs and shall undertake to promote entrepreneurship, support entrepreneurs, encourage the establishment of MSMEs and ensure their continuing viability and growth and thereby attain countryside industrialization.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-03-19, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-03-20 and received by the Senate on 2024-03-20

rows.author: J026;
rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SYSTEM PROTECTING THE COMMUNITY INTELLECTUAL
RIGHTS OF INDIGENOUS CULTURAL COMMUNITIES/INDIGENOUS PEOPLES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the following issues:Â  there were numerous cases of indigenous handicrafts, symbols, and attires which have been replicated by commercial knitting machines that swarmed the markets; and there are misleading claims that the said products allegedly originated from the Indigenous communities are rampantly found in the e-commerce platforms.
Proposes to entitle the ICCs/IPs of the full ownership, control, and protection from misappropriation, misuse, and false designation of origin of their community intellectual rights; Also proposes to recognize their rights to the restitution of their cultural, intellectual, religious, and spiritual property taken without their free, prior and informed consent or in violation of their laws, traditions, and customs, including the definition of corresponding penalties for the said violation/s.
Provides for the coordination by the NCIP with the NCCA and IPOPHL on the registry of community intellectual rights, cultural property, and intellectual property rights; Also provides for other implementing agencies as follows:Â  
 National Museum; National Library, National Historical Commission; National Archives; Cultural Center of the Phils.; Komisyon sa Wikang Filipino, Palawan Council on Sustainable Dev´t, DENR, DA, PITAHC, and civil society organizations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INDIGENOUS CULTURAL COMMUNITIES AND INDIGENOUS PEOPLES since 2024-03-11

AN ACT CONFIRMING AND DECLARING THE VALIDITY OF EXISTING TRANSFER
CERTIFICATES OF TITLE AND RECONSTITUTED CERTIFICATES COVERING FRIAR
LANDS
rows.abstract:
These friar lands cover approximately 164,127 hectares in  Laguna, Bulacan, Cavite, Bataan, Cebu, Rizal, Isabela, and Mindoro.
Seeks to address controversies involving the validity of the acquisition of these friar lands and the integrity of the Torrens system.  Aims to resolve the issue that friar lands records and Torrens titles have suffered damage or loss due to wars, floods, fires, and other force majeure events to the prejudice of the present title holders.

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PRACTICE OF MIDWIFERY AS A PROFESSION IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 2644, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS "THE PHILIPPINE MIDWIFERY LAW" AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7392, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PHILIPPINE MIDWIFERY ACT OF 1992
rows.title_short: Philippine Midwifery Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to adopt measures that will continuously improve the knowledge, skills and competence, and ethical standards of midwives in order to raise the standards of the midwifery profession, improve the delivery of midwifery services to the public and enable midwives to discharge their public responsibility more effectively.
Also seeks to promote and protect the midwifery profession, rights, and welfare, and provide better salaries and wage benefits to midwives.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-05-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-05-20 and received by the Senate on 2024-05-20

rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF COLD STORAGE FACILITIES IN EVERY PROVINCE FOR FOOD SECURITY
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 2024-03-13

rows.author: I089;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMPREHENSIVE DEFENSE PACKAGE FOR THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES, TO PROMOTE A FAST AND MASSIVE MILITARY BUILD-UP,TO FOSTER MODERN ASSETS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish at least one food security cold storage facility center for agricultural products in every province to ensure the preservation and safety of perishable agricultural products, such as crops, fruits, vegetables, and meat, and improve food security.
Provides that existing structures, facilities, and equipment could be improved to effectively serve as a defense package in compliance with rules and regulations set by the National Security Council (NSC), AFP, DND, and subject matter experts.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2024-03-13
